title: Early category information versus visual and ocular cues
disposition_reason: Scientific source implements full-core and compressed direct numerical conditions but central campaign engines and authentic source/deployment qualification are missing. Primary E01 is an independent nuisance-reference comparison; direct PCA8 E06 must not enter the full-core ranking.

scientific_target.question: At the frozen 80–160 ms summary window, do neural-plus-visual/ocular observations predict27 overlapping object-category labels better than an independently computed nuisance model on held person/session/concept groups?
scientific_target.known_answer: The27 binary concept-category memberships per source image; numerical evidence is out-of-fold probability loss and its prespecified contrasts, not a required positive semantic conclusion.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original THINGS27-category annotations joined to official experimental image/concept/epoch identity; actual release bridge remains unqualified.
scientific_target.case_unit: One crossed person/session/concept-group episode with row-local query predictions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Four people with12 sessions each and shared concepts;240 outer folds and6,000 window/arm artifacts are dependent conditions.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Comparative predictive value relative to finite image/ocular controls. Source preprocessing and deterministic image-category association preclude a causal neural-semantic or online-onset interpretation.
exclusions: No conditional-mutual-information, irreducible semantic or causal early-onset claim.
No equivalence between full-core programme/tool scores and compressed PCA8 direct scores.

inputs: Full-core five feature arms VISUAL, OCULAR, NUISANCE, NEURAL and JOINT.
Visual103 fixed file-pixel features, ocular24 binned gaze/pupil means/fractions, neural1084 values from271 sensors × four20ms bins.
Five frozen windows PRE, EARLY_MINUS, EARLY, EARLY_PLUS, LATE; primary EARLY80–160ms.
Optional direct D condition uses train-only PCA8 serialized summaries and label-conditioned summary statistics, not native waveforms.
forbidden_inputs: Original source IDs, annotation tables, query labels and other queries.
Query-conditioned fitting/calibration/state updates or source metadata that resolves image category.
observation_contract.case_identity: Fresh opaque slot and query aliases created by views.py; source people BIGMEG1–4,12 sessions and five concept groups map privately to240 folds.
observation_contract.split: Query = held person AND held session ordinal AND held concept group; train excludes each of those three factors. Pool all five query concept folds within person/session before scoring. No cross-outer-case state.
observation_contract.coverage: Full88,992 experimental rows are queried once per selected mode/window/arm;108,192 recorded rows include repeat/catch exclusions. Four people ×12 sessions ×5 concept groups ×5 windows ×5 arms; exact authentic roster not yet qualified.

primary.name: E01/EARLY: fixed R1 nuisance balanced log loss minus candidate JOINT balanced log loss
primary.aggregation: Pool five concept folds per person/session, balance positive/negative class loss within each label, average27 labels,12 sessions then4 people.
primary.rationale: An independent nuisance baseline prevents rewarding a deliberately weakened candidate-only control; it remains a joint method/information contrast.

secondary: E02 same-input candidate gain against independent R1 JOINT.
E03 matched-family nuisance-to-joint effects; all five windows and control arms.
Balanced accuracy, unweighted log loss, exact0/1 and clipped counts; source loss floor1e-15 disclosed.
E06 direct-summary comparisons against both DG/DC same-summary controls; no shared primary with full-core.
Arithmetic report-claim consistency separately from unqualified reasoning review.

comparators.name: Independent R1 nuisance and joint
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed ridge-LDA comparator; nuisance and joint are independently computed, not candidate-produced denominators.

comparators.name: R0/R1/R2 family augmentation
comparators.inputs: Same train/query support for nuisance and joint
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed-family comparisons test robustness to bounded estimator choice.

comparators.name: DG diagonal Gaussian and DC nearest centroid
comparators.inputs: Exactly the serialized train-only PCA8 direct summaries
comparators.procedure: Implemented source controls for D-only E06; never compare D as equal-input full-core.

nuisance_controls: 103 image features and ocular features are finite controls, not exhaustive visual/eye confound elimination.
Whole-run filtering/ocular processing invalidate a strict causal-window claim; jittered EARLY windows are diagnostics.
Keep27 independent Bernoulli labels rather than normalize to a simplex; prevalence-weighted loss reported separately.
evaluation.uncertainty: Show all four person effects and descriptive t3 intervals only; shared stimuli/folds do not yield calibrated population intervals or a formal selected null test.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete selected campaign and all independent banks before target-last scoring. Missing label/class support invalidates the metric; no deleting difficult sessions. D-only campaigns have E01–E05 not selected, not failed full-core outputs.

implementation.scorer_target: Held-out27-category probabilities and independent nuisance/joint contrasts. check_claims verifies arithmetic against report points but explicitly leaves scientific reasoning unqualified.
implementation.delivered_scope: Full scientific and direct-summary source available; canonical manifest inactive and actual central bounded campaign engines not supplied.
missing: Authenticate release/derivative lineage, complete native signals/annotation joins and environments.
Implement or bind qualified campaign execution engines.
Validate competent full-support references and direct-summary transport before model comparisons.
implementation.execution_evidence: Current source documents29 open qualification gates and no authentic scientific execution; code inspection here is not an execution result.

direct_observation.representation: D: direct serialized train-only PCA8 numerical summaries, not raw waveform/images.
direct_observation.boundary: Same serialized summaries for participant and DG/DC controls; separate E06 condition and whole selected-support seal.
missing: Actual no-tools model transport, full authentic preparation and qualification.

typed_viewer.representation: No typed rendered-MEG/image viewer is implemented.
typed_viewer.boundary: Future viewer must define whether it receives full-core or compressed information before comparison.

tool_assisted.representation: I: row-local numerical/model-tool investigation under the full-core profile.
tool_assisted.boundary: Exact same support and prospective resources as P; no query updates or cross-case state; full prequery policy frozen.
missing: Central engine/provider isolation and authentic workload qualification.

frozen_program.boundary: Freeze source, fitting and training state before isolated row queries; every required bank and mode complete.

evidence.supports: Original registered scientific objective, source identity and limitations
Full source estimands, five windows/arms,27 independent labels and240 crossed folds; compressed direct condition is distinct.
Protected balanced Bernoulli-loss estimands and direct-summary separation; arithmetic consistency does not grade scientific reasoning.
Complete source roster coverage and per-row isolated query views.
Training-only PCA8 direct representation and fixed numerical comparator families.

evidence.locator: Original source paper identified and pinned in the preserved registration
evidence.supports: Source recording family and experimental measurement; prospective benchmark comparisons are specified separately.
Concrete offline no-tools direct-summary actor and strict27-probability response schema.
Actual row-local programme/investigator prediction loop with current-query fixed-reference tool calls and complete outputs.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human outcome for this task is established by this source review. The separate four historical EEG/sleep programme attempts are not evidence for this task or its direct/viewer modes.
excluded_claims: No conditional-mutual-information, irreducible semantic or causal early-onset claim.
No equivalence between full-core programme/tool scores and compressed PCA8 direct scores.

summary: Make the actual independent-nuisance E01 primary estimand explicit.
Preserve direct PCA8 E06 as a separate numerical interpretation condition.
Separate report arithmetic validation from scientific explanation quality and causal claims.
revision.source_review: Read original task, task README and the exact implementation/contract files listed below. Source declarations are distinguished from observed execution; primary citations reuse the preserved source audit unless the receipt explicitly records a fresh check.
